div.p: Pre-join history is opaque — a new member gets only current+future epoch keys (same property as Megolm). Post-removal is opaque to the removed member, but messages they already held stay readable: rotation protects the future, not the past. Wrapping is DHKEM(X25519,HKDF-SHA256)/AES-256-GCM over each device's Ed25519 key mapped to X25519.
